description: Use before acting on a Hyperliquid perpetual to see whether it is crowded or in a hype state and what historically followed. Returns 7-day move, funding (hourly, APR, percentile vs its own 90 days and vs all perps), open interest and its 24h/7d change, premium, Wikipedia attention, active crowd states, and each state's base rates (sample size, median and spread of 7/30/90-day returns). Signed. Not investment advice. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).

coin.description: Hyperliquid perp symbol, for example BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, kPEPE (case-sensitive)
